name: Open Library
summary: Open, editable library catalog with 3M+ books to read or borrow free, browsable by subject, author, lists and collections.
description: An open, editable library catalog working towards a web page for every book ever published, holding 20M+ gathered records and more than 3M books to read or borrow online. Browse by subject, trending, author or reader-curated collections, borrow through controlled digital lending, search the full text of millions of books, and keep a reading log and yearly goals. Community-editable like a wiki; free to use.
contains: 3M+ books to read or borrow for free
controlled digital lending for in-copyright books
browse by subject, author, trending, lists and curated collections
full-text search inside millions of books
reader lists, reading log and yearly reading goals
community editing; 283,946 ebooks borrowed in the last 28 days
